LVL 2 > BOSS
♥♡♡ 17/30
Boss fight: merge conflict ⚔️
PlayerController.cs ⚠️
Accept Current | Accept Incoming | Accept Both | Compare
<<<<<<< HEAD (your change)
float jumpForce = 10f;
=======
float jumpForce = 9000f; // trust me bro
>>>>>>> feature/super-jump (theirs)
HOW TO WIN
  1. Don’t panic. It’s normal.
  2. Keep the right line (or both)
  3. Delete the <<< === >>> markers
  4. git add . then git commit
  5. Talk to your teammate 🤝
Happens when two people change the same line differently. Git can’t guess who’s right, so it asks you.
it’s not a bug, it’s a boss 😤

♥♥♥ 18/30
Don’t upload the junk 🗑
A .gitignore file lists stuff Git should skip, like Unity’s giant auto-generated Library folder.
.gitignore · Unity
# Unity rebuilds these itself
[Ll]ibrary/
[Tt]emp/
[Oo]bj/
[Bb]uild/
[Bb]uilds/
[Ll]ogs/
[Uu]ser[Ss]ettings/
# IDE files
*.csproj
*.sln
.gitignore · Godot 4
# Godot’s cache folder
.godot/
# your exported builds
builds/
🎁 Free templates
Pick one when you create a repo on GitHub, or grab it from
github.com/github/gitignore
Library/ = GBs of nope 🙅

LVL 4 > PRO TIPS
♥♥♥ 26/30
Pro tips for game repos
🐘
Git LFS for big files
PSDs, WAVs, 3D models go in Large File Storage
git lfs track "*.psd"
🍰
Commit small & often
One feature per save. Way easier to undo one thing.
📝
Messages = patch notes
“Fix enemy spawning in walls”, not “stuff”
🔑
Never commit secrets
API keys & passwords stay out. Bots scan public repos.
🎬
One scene, one person
Scene files merge badly. Split work into prefabs.
🔄
Pull before you push
Dodges most merge conflicts before they spawn.
